card.name: Linking words before a noun phrase
card.fires_on: Small connecting words (the, such, of, up, kept) in the middle of a clause, right before the expected object or noun, in technical or scientific prose. The next word is usually a concrete noun or measure.

modes.label: Articles and prepositions
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'of' sits after a verb or noun and leads into a technical object.

modes.label: Such / verbs before examples
modes.description: Words like 'such', 'kept', 'provide' or 'pulled up' introduce an example, a manner or a quantity.
